artworks.title: Orestes Pursued by the Furies
artworks.description: Bouguereau's Orestes clings to Apollo's altar while the Erinyes press close — the madness after the matricide that the Areopagus trial would end.

artworks.title: Electra at the Tomb of Agamemnon
artworks.description: Leighton's Electra at her father's tomb — the sister who saved Orestes and waited for the vengeance Homer celebrated.
